selection_basis: Candidate models from 4 to 10 topics were compared using reconstruction error, topic diversity, topic separation, topic sizes, keywords, and qualitative inspection of representative documents.
stress_interpretation: Topics are learned independently from all 2,666 posts. Predicted Stress is used only after topic assignment to test association.
causal_warning: Topic associations with predicted Stress must not be interpreted as causal effects or clinical psychological conclusions.
